meta.description: Answers to common appliance repair questions: pricing, the service call fee, scheduling, warranty and which brands Northline Appliance Repair fixes in Austin.

overview: Straight answers about pricing, scheduling and what happens on the visit.

faq.q: How much is the service call?
faq.a: There is a service call fee, waived when you approve the repair.

faq.q: Will I know the price before you start?
faq.a: Yes. You get a written price and nothing starts until you approve it.
Monday to Friday 8 AM to 7 PM, Saturday 9 AM to 3 PM.

faq.q: Will the technician call before arriving?
faq.a: Yes. You get a call or text when the technician is on the way.
Every repair carries a 90-day warranty on parts and labor.

closing.body: Call us or book online and we will walk you through it.
